summary: Read-only ponytail audit of create-narduk-app, design-system-build, narduk-app, and narduk-ui. 20 findings: 7 must, 12 should, 1 nice. 17 smaller ones left out. Must-fix: the JSON body reader accepts form posts and has no size cap; upgrade --write advances a CI pin the caller cannot start; Dependabot npm limit 1 blocks the safe lane; NsRangeBar layout; naive timestamps disagree between UTC Workers and US browsers.
